obligations.statement: Whatever day it picks, trackingDueAt returns 18:00 local clock time in tz in both summer and winter (16:00Z under CEST, 17:00Z under CET) rather than a fixed UTC offset; e.g. an order placed Wednesday 2026-01-14 at 09:00 CET (08:00Z) is due 2026-01-14T17:00:00.000Z.
